Teela is  Kagha's death viper snake. She is loyal to Kagha, but may be willing to listen to reason over her owner. She is in the Emerald Grove during Act One.
“
A new hatchling? Yes. They can be foolish.
„
— Teela

Involvement

Act One

Upon entering the Inner Sanctum of the Emerald Grove, Teela, Kagha, and  Rath are discussing  Arabella's fate after she was caught stealing the  Idol of Silvanus. Teela is poised to intervene if Arabella struggles or tries to escape. A party member can intervene to ⁠Save Arabella.

If a non-druid character tells Teela to stay at ease, she responds that she only takes orders from Kagha. However, she listens to druids, agreeing that hatchlings can be foolish. She tells Kagha, "Kagha si nay. Wux geou fulla wer fanol." which convinces Kagha to relent from punishing the child.

Should Arabella struggle or try to run, Teela bites Arabella, who immediately succumbs to her venom. After the cutscene is resolved, Teela disappears and is not seen again.
